title: Fateforge: Chronicles of Kaan
subtitle: An app-driven cooperative action-adventure campaign of tactical combat and branching fantasy narrative
tagline: Unleash kinetic dice maneuvers and forge your legend across the realm of Kaan
loreSummary: In the vibrant yet perilous world of Eana, you are heroes navigating political intrigue, ancient conspiracies, and ferocious beasts. Guided by an atmospheric digital game master, every decision shapes the unfolding chronicle of Kaan.
keyFeatures: Bite-sized episodic pacing with 45–60 minute combat and narrative scenes
Dynamic kinetic combat powered by clever dice placement and combo maneuvers
Digital companion app acting as an automated game master and reactive storyteller
Branching multi-act storyline with meaningful choices and varied campaign paths

fateforge_standard.name: Standard Core Chronicle
fateforge_standard.description: The complete three-act campaign experience covering the central storyline, pivotal side scenes, and key character upgrades.

fateforge_story.name: Story Focus (Main Arc)
fateforge_story.description: A streamlined path through the critical narrative missions of all three acts with minimal optional side diversions.

fateforge_completionist.name: Grand Saga & Expansion
fateforge_completionist.description: Exhaustive exploration of all branching narrative branches, hidden challenges, and the Clash of the Immortals expansion content.

milestones.title: Infiltration of the Outskirts
milestones.phase: Act I - Shadows of the Borderlands
milestones.description: Entering the turbulent lands of Kaan, overcoming initial perimeter skirmishes, and establishing your party's reputation with local allies.

milestones.title: The Heart of the Intrigue
milestones.description: Unraveling political treachery within the fortified bastion, braving escalated tactical skirmishes, and discovering the conspiracy threatening Eana.

milestones.title: Fate of the Free Realm
milestones.phase: Act III - Climax of the Immortals
milestones.description: Confronting the ultimate adversarial force in a multi-stage showdown, deciding the balance of power, and cementing the legendary chronicle of Kaan.
